import CategoryTheory.Limits
import CategoryTheory.Functor
import CategoryTheory.Category
import Fintype

open CategoryTheory

theorem lg_target {G : Type v} [Group G] [Finite G] :
  CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesColimitsOfShape (CategoryTheory.SingleObj G) FintypeCat.incl := by
  let J := CategoryTheory.SingleObj G
  let F := FintypeCat.incl
  let C := FintypeCat
  let D := Type v

  have h : CategoryTheory.Limits.HasColimitsOfShape J C :=
    sorry -- This would be proven using properties of finite colimits in Fintype

  have k : CategoryTheory.Limits.HasColimitsOfShape J D :=
    sorry -- This is trivially true as all colimits exist in Type

  let l : CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesColimitsOfShape J F :=
    CategoryTheory.Limits.evaluation_preservesColimitsOfShape J F h k

  exact l
